verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents the Storage Write API (gRPC) for streaming data in, with exactly-once delivery semantics. It also documents Pub/Sub BigQuery subscriptions that load data in real time as it is generated, and continuous queries that analyze incoming data in real time. Missing for 10: an explicit documented seconds-level time from write to queryable (only 'real-time'/'near real time' wording), and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency.
